Salman Khan to be first guest on Koffee With Karan final season

Actor Salman Khan will be the first guest on the final season of the talk show "Koffee With Karan," which is set to premiere on October 14. A promo released shows Khan engaging in a witty exchange with host Karan Johar, announcing the show's return. Fans have expressed excitement about his appearance.
